title: The Mist-Archive Where Altitude Learned to Breathe

features.name: the breathing stone
features.desc-on-touch: A marker at the altitude threshold—you watch it exhale mist as your own breath learns to thin. The stone remembers when the air could hold more.

features.name: edge-becoming-aware
features.desc-on-touch: Where mist meets the painted field—a boundary that learns itself as you observe it. The archive's own edge, breathing.

features.name: the altitude's unravelling
features.desc-on-touch: Stone and sky so close here that neither knows which one is learning. The archive reads both at once.

features.name: pale wind-learning
features.desc-on-touch: The mist-archive keeps this field clear the way wind clears a page. Each moment it is rewritten and forgets.

features.name: the listening height
features.desc-on-touch: You are higher than breath wants to go. The archive listens from this altitude—it hears the stone saying things sky-speech cannot translate.

reverie.title: REVERIE — altitude learning to hold breath
narr: You stand above the mist where it began,
watching it remember the ground it rose from.
Her hand finds your shoulder—neither of you
breathing quite right, both of you learning.
Stone below; sky above; you two learning
to be the only thing that knew how to stand.

inscription: mist learns to remember; the archive learns to breathe when stone stops arguing
